hook: The Mercator map projection is officially being replaced by the more accurate Equal Earth map.

sections.voiceover: The Mercator map projection is officially being replaced by the more accurate Equal Earth map.
On September 4, 2026, the United Nations General Assembly voted to ditch the 1569 Mercator projection. Why does the 1569 Mercator projection misrepresent the relative size of the African continent?
Except the truth is that Africa is actually 14 times larger than Greenland.
Spearheaded by Togo and the African Union, the Equal Earth map is the official fix. This resolution addresses the geometric distortions created by Gerardus Mercator centuries ago.
Only 1 nation voted against the resolution to adopt the new Equal Earth map.
